pages.summary: La familia descansa sobre las toallas a la sombra. Gnocchi reparte bebidas frías y Pansy pregunta por Draco y Astoria, que han regresado al velero.

panels.scene: Establishing full-width view from a shaded dry low stone slab covered with large cream towels, across headland toward the one anchored navy ketch, with side deck and one stable wood plank gangway. On center-right golden-haired Daphne in opaque turquoise suit/cream pareo holds Arianna securely on lap, teal towel around her. Scorpius pale platinum in gray wrap leans against seated Blaise's leg on cream towel, and chestnut Robin sits between the adults in his dry ivory wrap and blue duck shorts, ONE adult navy gold captain hat still on Robin. At left Hermione and Pansy reach their shaded seats, still visible with distinct hair and appropriate olive/black swim clothes. All dry children with real human faces.

At left Hermione wears olive suit and carefully dabs the chestnut curls still gathered in her high messy bun with a pale towel. Beside her Pansy short black cropped chin bob uses two separate normal hands to put on her open lightweight beach shirt over black outer swimsuit, keeps glasses. At edge on a dry rock, Robin's ivory sunhat with blue ribbon remains separate from borrowed navy one. No text.

Gnocchi, a SHORT plump elderly elf in sand uniform and creamy visor, stands beside the seated group as a skilled adult. Long pointed ears and round little face unlike other crew. At same eyeline as seated Pansy, NOT adult human standing scale. He carefully balances one cold-drinks tray for Daphne and Pansy taking two orange drinks in flutes. No drink anywhere near a child. Hermione pale towel around shoulders, all still seated safely on towels.

Wide shot, elf holds the same tray on his real connected forearm. Hermione receives one clear tall glass with small lemon slices; Blaise (very short black curls, navy shorts), using his own hand, accepts the last orange flute and nods to elf. The now-empty tray carries no spare drinks. Daphne and Pansy each have one orange glass placed far from unsupervised little hands. Scorpius still by Blaise's leg, Robin between the adults with same navy cap, Daphne holds Arianna teal-wrap on lap; art communicates quiet rest. One same yacht in distant background at edge. No lettering.

Pansy scans toward the yacht from her seated spot on the pale towel and asks her exact line. Close neck and shoulder view with black shirt over suit, original angular black bob, black translucent lenses, gold clip anatomical LEFT. Hermione beside her with chestnut bun and olive suit, pale towel and own sapphire pendant. One clear balloon points to Pansy.

Daphne cradles Arianna close on her lap with an arm securely around her, and points slightly by lifting her glass in the direction of the companionway in the one yacht. One speech bubble only to golden-haired Daphne. Seen over the adults, one short plank gangway attached from rock to yacht side, no invented passengers.

Full-width. Blaise glances from the wooden companionway to little platinum-haired Scorpius leaning safely against his left leg; joking expression, same short black curls and dark complexion. Daphne with Arianna on lap, Pansy looking up and Hermione suppressing a smile behind her lemon glass. Only Blaise's complete long sentence in one big legible balloon in the open upper plane, tail pointing directly to his face. No Draco or Astoria shown.
dialogue: Blaise: No puedo creer que me hayan convertido en el tío responsable mientras ellos desaparecen dentro de mi velero.

panels.scene: Wide group rest in shade over dry pale towels. Daphne LEFT CENTER casually says her entire short line, one balloon points to her. Blaise to her right turns slowly to look at her with amused attention. Pansy black open beach shirt looks toward the yacht stairs in the distance. Hermione keeps her smile behind the clear lemon glass, no blue jewelry anywhere but her sapphire. Exactly same support positions: turquoise golden Arianna on Daphne, platinum gray Scorpius against Blaise's leg, navy captain hat chestnut Robin between them. No additional people or words.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 13 · 73

La familia descansa sobre las toallas a la sombra. Gnocchi reparte bebidas frías y Pansy pregunta por Draco y Astoria, que han regresado al velero.
Pansy: ¿Dónde están Draco y Astoria?
Daphne: Subieron hace un rato.
Blaise: No puedo creer que me hayan convertido en el tío responsable mientras ellos desaparecen dentro de mi velero.
Daphne: Seguramente necesitaban cambiarse.
pages.review: PDF641: Gnocchi conserva su aspecto y altura de elfo adulto. Daphne y Pansy reciben una mimosa cada una; Hermione sirve limón y Blaise toma la última. Los niños secos y envueltos mantienen cada posición. Pansy se pone la camisa negra después de salir del agua. Se corrigió el apoyo de la pasarela en las vistas junto a las toallas. Los cuatro diálogos permanecen completos y atribuidos.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 13 · 74

Blaise intenta proteger a los bebés de las bromas sobre sus padres. El recuerdo del agua de manantial cambia enseguida el blanco de las risas hacia Pansy.
Blaise: Los dos. Al mismo tiempo.
Pansy: Draco necesita ayuda con muchas cosas. Quizá el bañador sea una de ellas.
Daphne: Astoria solo está siendo una novia atenta.
Blaise: Hay niños presentes.
Pansy: Robin está acostumbrado a vernos besarnos. No creo que esto vaya a preocuparle.
Daphne: Eso es ahora. Yo todavía recuerdo la noche en que apareciste en nuestra habitación con el pretexto del agua de manantial.
Blaise: Por Merlín, el agua de manantial. Entraste con tanta prisa que pensé que alguien te perseguía.
Hermione: Sabía que era un pretexto.
pages.review: Ocho turnos íntegros cotejados con PDF641–642. Blaise sostiene a Scorpius con naturalidad y le cubre las orejas; Pansy recoge a Robin y conserva su brazalete izquierdo y el sombrero prestado. Daphne y Arianna mantienen sus rasgos y vestuario. En la escena del recuerdo hay un solo barco, con su pasarela apoyada en la roca.
